messages:
daniela: heads-up — sable private VPC change window tonight 02:00–02:30 UTC. I will own the deploy and rollback decisions.

matt: copying. i'll be on rollback standby and watching traffic routing. which region is this in?

daniela: us-east-1. customer asked for minimal downtime; plan is canary -> 20% -> 100% with 10m soak at each stage.

rachel: I can own smoke checks and logs. will run health and inference smoke every stage.

siva: are we using the kv-cache warmers and prefix-caching enabled for this rollout? we should to avoid cold-start token spikes.

daniela: yes, prefix caching enabled. preflight will warm caches with preflight script. also running quantized variant on canary nodes.

matt: preflight checklist: VPN tunnel up? KMS access for model keys? routing rules in Cloud Router? certs valid?

daniela: VPN OK (verified), KMS OK, routing rule change staged but not flipped. certs expire in >90d.

rachel: smoke test script (will run after each stage):
```bash
# basic health
curl -sS -f https://private-sable-api.internal/health || exit 1
# basic inference
curl -sS -X POST https://private-sable-api.internal/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.text' | grep -q "smoke"
```

deploy-bot: deploying sable-inference v2.3.1 -> canary (nodes: sable-canary-01,sable-canary-02). job id: db-7890

rachel: started smoke tests against canary. health OK on both nodes. basic inference returned token stream and expected tag.

matt: watching metrics — token latency stable, p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 420ms. CPU ~ 68%, GPU util ~ 54%. no OOM.

daniela: proceeding to 20%. matt if you call rollback, shout here and i'll ack.

matt: ack. ready to rollback if error rate >1% or latency >1s p95 for >2m.

rachel: 20% stage smoke: health OK, sample eval set passing, no TLS handshake errors.

siva: quick note — the customer has strict egress rules; if we see failing webhooks from analytics, don't flip routing until we verify NAT gateway logs.

daniela: noted. will hold at 20% for 12m and re-check NAT logs.

deploy-bot: rollout to 20% complete. scaling to 6 nodes.

matt: NAT logs look clean. moving to 100% in 3 minutes unless objections.

rachel: no objections from me. I'll do a full run of the smoke suite pre-flip.

daniela: flip at +03:17 UTC. rolling to 100% now — monitoring dashboards pinned.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete.

matt: post-rollout checks: all api endpoints healthy, latency p95 490ms, error rate 0.2%.

siva: double-checking audit logs for KMS access — all good.

rachel: running final inference sampling on production topology — sample set passes.

daniela: thanks everyone. leaving the window open for 30m observation. if anything flares up, i'll initiate rollback. otherwise i'll mark the change as complete. :thumbsup:

matt: great, thanks. i'll stand down in 30m unless i shout.

deploy-bot: change marked: sable-deploy-1862223333 -> completed, snooze 30m for observation. job db-7890.
